title: Go Go HarmoniYo asset register
description: Machine-readable provenance and license register for every non-code asset (ADR-0008). tools/licensing/attribution.mjs validates it, checks coverage and pinned hashes, and generates ATTRIBUTION.md and attribution/credits.json.

coverage.description: Which repository files count as assets. Every matching file must be claimed by exactly one register entry.

include.description: Extra globs for assets without a telling extension (e.g. chart JSON).

spdxExpression.description: SPDX license expression; every id must have a file in LICENSES/ and be allowed by tools/licensing/policy.json (or an ADR exception).

ai.description: Provenance for AI-generated or AI-assisted content (ADR-0008). Legacy (pre-ADR-0008) entries may use "unrecorded" / "pending"; new entries may not.

tool.description: Product or service, e.g. an image generator or coding agent.

termsUrl.description: Terms of service that grant output rights and permit redistribution.

termsDate.description: Version/date of the terms that applied.

prompt.description: Full prompt (or a repo path to a prompt log). Never franchise or artist names.

reviewer.description: Human who did the resemblance review.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the upstream file (text files compared with LF line endings).

origin.description: original = human-made for this project; ai-generated = made with a gen-AI tool; third-party = someone else's work; derived = produced by project code from other register entries.

attribution.description: Exact credit text to display (in ATTRIBUTION.md and in-game credits).

licenseEvidence.description: Where the license was verified (page, in-file notice).

reuseLimits.description: Conditions downstream users must keep (notices, ShareAlike, NC, trademarks).

legacy.description: Added before ADR-0008; incomplete AI provenance is allowed but must be listed as a gap.

candidate.description: Spike candidate kept for owner review (ADR-0011, Proposed): not used by any game build and not credited. Its human resemblance review (ai.reviewer/ai.reviewDate) may be pending; it must be done, and this flag removed, before the asset is promoted or shipped.
